source.name: Cricsheet
source.note: Ball-by-ball facts from Cricsheet. Ball descriptions are original text, not broadcast commentary.

video.title: Topley Makes History at Lord's | ODI IN FULL | England v India 2022

players.name: Jason Roy
players.story: Explosive opener who tries to set the tone in the first over.

players.name: Jonny Bairstow
players.story: Powerful opener; once he is in, big hundreds tend to follow.

players.name: Joe Root
players.story: England's most elegant run-scorer; makes batting look easy.

players.name: Ben Stokes
players.story: Big-match all-rounder and the hero of the 2019 World Cup final at this very ground.

players.name: Jos Buttler
players.story: England's white-ball captain and keeper; can hit any ball anywhere.

players.name: Liam Livingstone
players.story: Six-hitting machine who bowls both off-spin and leg-spin.

players.name: Moeen Ali
players.story: Off-spinning all-rounder with one of the prettiest cover drives around.

players.name: David Willey
players.story: Left-arm swing bowler who loves a new ball and a cloudy sky.

players.name: Craig Overton
players.story: Tall Somerset seamer who gets awkward bounce.

players.name: Brydon Carse
players.story: Skiddy, aggressive fast bowler from Durham.

players.name: Reece Topley
players.story: Very tall left-arm seamer whose career was nearly ended by repeated back injuries.

players.name: Rohit Sharma
players.story: India's captain and opener; the only batter with three ODI double-hundreds.

players.name: Shikhar Dhawan
players.story: Left-handed opener who saves his best for ICC events; famous for the thigh-slap celebration.

players.name: Virat Kohli
players.story: Run machine with over 40 ODI hundreds; chasing a target is his favourite sport.

players.name: Rishabh Pant
players.story: Fearless keeper-batter who plays shots nobody else would even try.

players.name: Suryakumar Yadav
players.story: 360-degree batter who scoops and ramps the quicks for fun.

players.name: Hardik Pandya
players.story: Seam-bowling all-rounder and big hitter; India's finisher when it gets tight.

players.name: Ravindra Jadeja
players.story: Left-arm spinner, gun fielder, and the sword-twirling celebration after a fifty.

players.name: Mohammed Shami
players.story: Seamer with a beautifully upright seam; lethal with the new ball.

players.name: Jasprit Bumrah
players.story: Unique slingy action and yorkers on demand; India's spearhead.

players.name: Yuzvendra Chahal
players.story: Leg-spinner and former junior chess player who loves tempting batters into a slog.

players.name: Prasidh Krishna
players.story: Tall fast bowler from Karnataka who hits the deck hard.
